Direct 2x2 multiplication gives skew commutator amplitude (s-t)/(sqrt2 pi) exp(-((s-u)^2+(t-u)^2)); completing square gives kappa_d exp(-2(u-m)^2), kappa_d=d exp(-d^2/2)/(sqrt2 pi). Multiplication-operator spectral theorem yields full imaginary band, entirely essential and absolutely continuous, multiplicity two on each sign and no eigenvalues. Nonzero scalar Gaussian multiplier noncompact on nonatomic measure space; peak measure zero gives nonattained norm; scalar derivative maximizes at d=1. Independently checked numeric values for d=.4,1,2, not substituted for proof.
